title: Prepositions of Place

expressions.example: Your keys? They're right there on the table.
I can't find my phone. Is it under the sofa?
The pharmacy is around the corner.
The park is in the middle of the city.

sentences: The keys are in my pocket.
The book is on the table.
I am at the bus stop.
The dog is under the bed.
The bank is between the pharmacy and the supermarket.
My car is in front of the house.
The clock is on the wall.

grammar.title: Preposições de Lugar — The Target Method
rules: AT = ponto específico, endereço preciso: at the bus stop, at school, at home
ON = superfície (tocando em cima): on the table, on the wall, on the floor
IN = dentro de (limites fechados): in the box, in Brazil, in the room
UNDER = embaixo | BETWEEN = entre dois | NEXT TO = ao lado

rows: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.

quiz.q: The cat is hiding ___ the chair.
The bank is ___ the pharmacy and the school.

speak: The keys are in my pocket.
We are next to the park.
